title: Display switcher offers List, Tech View, Board View and marks the active one
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. On the Work Orders page.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Work Orders page.
  2. Look at the display controls on the right of the toolbar.
  3. Note which control is highlighted.
  4. Click a different display control.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Work Orders toolbar shows three display-option controls: List, Tech View, and Board View.
  • The control for the display you are currently viewing is clearly marked as the active one.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10044 — Story 1 Switch between display options. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S1-R1, S1-R9 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R1: “The Work Orders toolbar offers List, Tech View, and Board View display options.”
  • S1-R9: “The switcher visually indicates the active display option.”
